name: Agano (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Agano city emblem in navy, green and red: a navy stylised swirl with a green stroke and a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Agano, a city in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 2004.

features.role: Agano city emblem — a navy stylised swirl with a green stroke and a red disc
